gates.unit: tests/battle-floor.test.mjs, tests/battle-smoke.test.mjs, tests/battle-cinema.test.mjs, tests/host-battle-knowledge.test.mjs, tests/battle-motion.test.mjs, tests/battle-film.test.mjs, tests/battle-choreography.test.mjs, tests/battle-plumes.test.mjs: the named test and no other

unit.name: a fight floored under three seconds a tick
unit.expect: every fight has a floor, and at every pace its fighting is watched at least that long and never faster than before
failed: every fight has a floor, and at every pace its fighting is watched at least that long and never faster than before

unit.name: the lead-ups floored too
unit.expect: the clock asks for the floor exactly while the fighting is fought, and Gonzales at Quick lasts its two minutes
failed: the clock asks for the floor exactly while the fighting is fought, and Gonzales at Quick lasts its two minutes

unit.name: the server tells the floor and never waits it
unit.expect: the server waits the floor between the fighting ticks and tells the page the tick and the pace apart; a test class keeps its pace
failed: the server waits the floor between the fighting ticks and tells the page the tick and the pace apart; a test class keeps its pace

unit.name: the real server not given the floor
unit.expect: the real server floors its fights; the pace buttons read the pace, not the tick
failed: the real server floors its fights; the pace buttons read the pace, not the tick

unit.name: a tick's movement not reckoned in its length
unit.expect: nobody in a fight is drawn moving faster than a quick march on foot or a canter on a horse, at any pace
failed: nobody in a fight is drawn moving faster than a quick march on foot or a canter on a horse, at any pace

unit.name: the banks never thicker than half
unit.expect: the smoke builds up under repeated fire until the firing line stands hidden in it, and is drawn over the men
failed: the smoke builds up under repeated fire until the firing line stands hidden in it, and is drawn over the men

unit.name: the banks never thin
unit.expect: the smoke drifts with the wind, lingers tens of seconds after the fire stops, and thins slowly away
failed: the smoke drifts with the wind, lingers tens of seconds after the fire stops, and thins slowly away

unit.name: a gun's shot no more smoke than a musket's
unit.expect: a gun makes a bank of its own that outlasts a musket's
failed: a gun makes a bank of its own that outlasts a musket's

unit.name: a bank for every shot past the cap
unit.expect: however long the firing, the smoke on the field stays bounded
failed: however long the firing, the smoke on the field stays bounded

unit.name: no haze for less motion
unit.expect: for less motion nothing grows or drifts: a still haze stands over the lines that are firing
failed: for less motion nothing grows or drifts: a still haze stands over the lines that are firing

unit.name: a shot's smoke not thrown out of the muzzle
unit.expect: a shot throws a plume bigger than the man who fired it, out of the muzzle the way he faces, and up
failed: a shot throws a plume bigger than the man who fired it, out of the muzzle the way he faces, and up

unit.name: a volley's smoke lies in heaps, not a wall
unit.expect: a volley rolls out a wall of smoke along the rank
failed: a volley rolls out a wall of smoke along the rank

unit.name: a gun's smoke a heap, not a column
unit.expect: a gun blasts a column of smoke that climbs and spreads
failed: a gun blasts a column of smoke that climbs and spreads

unit.name: the smoke never more than thin
unit.expect: a long fight ends half-shrouded in its own smoke
failed: a long fight ends half-shrouded in its own smoke

unit.name: the musket at the library clip's own speed
unit.expect: a man aims, fires and is seen loading over seconds, and fires about three times a minute
failed: a man aims, fires and is seen loading over seconds, and fires about three times a minute

unit.name: the officer's words a blink apart
unit.expect: the officer's three words are each long enough to read, and a rank's turn comes round every twenty seconds
failed: the officer's three words are each long enough to read, and a rank's turn comes round every twenty seconds

unit.name: a man falls in a frame
unit.expect: a man hit staggers and goes down over seconds, and the men of one fall go down a moment apart
failed: a man hit staggers and goes down over seconds, and the men of one fall go down a moment apart

unit.name: the gun fires in a blink
unit.expect: a gun's crew stands ready before a shot the page knows is coming, and the gun recoils over more than a second and a half
failed: a gun's crew stands ready before a shot the page knows is coming, and the gun recoils over more than a second and a half

unit.name: the Alamo filmed only for its assault
unit.expect: the major events are filmed with nobody's family there, from the first shot to the last, and the Alamo from the army's coming to the burial
failed: the major events are filmed with nobody's family there, from the first shot to the last, and the Alamo from the army's coming to the burial

unit.name: the film stops when the family's man falls
unit.expect: a minor fight is filmed only with a played family's man in it, and stays filmed after he falls
failed: a minor fight is filmed only with a played family's man in it, and stays filmed after he falls

unit.name: the Host never told what to film
unit.expect: the Host is told what the class view films during Gonzales with no family in it; nobody else is told
failed: the Host is told what the class view films during Gonzales with no family in it; nobody else is told

unit.name: no establishing shot from far off
unit.expect: on the Host it starts by itself: a fade to black, the field from far off with a title, pushing in, and the fade up
failed: on the Host it starts by itself: a fade to black, the field from far off with a title, pushing in, and the fade up

unit.name: no hold on a man hit
unit.expect: it follows the field and each of the class's own people in turn, gliding, and holds a moment on one shown hit, then never follows him again
failed: it follows the field and each of the class's own people in turn, gliding, and holds a moment on one shown hit, then never follows him again

unit.name: no hold on the field before the fade
unit.expect: when the fighting is over it holds on the field while the smoke clears, fades, and puts the teacher's view back
failed: when the fighting is over it holds on the field while the smoke clears, fades, and puts the teacher's view back

unit.name: a fight gone from the map cuts the film off
unit.expect: when the fighting is over it holds on the field while the smoke clears, fades, and puts the teacher's view back
failed: when the fighting is over it holds on the field while the smoke clears, fades, and puts the teacher's view back

unit.name: the film takes the camera back from the teacher
unit.expect: the teacher takes the camera at any moment, keeps it for that fight, and can give it back; nothing is put back after
failed: the teacher takes the camera at any moment, keeps it for that fight, and can give it back; nothing is put back after

unit.name: the film goes on over the end of the game
unit.expect: the end of the game stops it at once; another fight sent in its place is cut to through black; less motion cuts
failed: the end of the game stops it at once; another fight sent in its place is cut to through black; less motion cuts

unit.name: a student's camera taken without Watch
unit.expect: a student's page never starts it by itself; Watch starts the follow on the family's own, with no fade and no title
failed: a student's page never starts it by itself; Watch starts the follow on the family's own, with no fade and no title

unit.name: every family the same colour
unit.expect: each family keeps one colour, told apart from the next
failed: each family keeps one colour, told apart from the next

unit.name: no jolt for a gun's shot
unit.expect: a gun's shot jolts the film's camera a few pixels for half a second; never for less motion, never when the teacher has it
failed: a gun's shot jolts the film's camera a few pixels for half a second; never for less motion, never when the teacher has it

unit.name: a fate sent before its minute
unit.expect: the Host is shown a family's man in the fight from the start and his fate only from its minute: nothing on its wire says it sooner
failed: the Host is shown a family's man in the fight from the start and his fate only from its minute: nothing on its wire says it sooner

browser.expect: the fighting's ticks were not held to the floor
browser.failure: the fighting's ticks were not held to the floor: [400] (floor 1765)

browser.expect: no fade to black before the fight

browser.expect: Esc did not take the camera
browser.failure: Esc did not take the camera

browser.expect: a page asking for less motion was faded
browser.failure: a page asking for less motion was faded

browser.expect: the camera was not put back

browser.expect: the smoke did not lie on the field twenty seconds
browser.failure: the smoke did not lie on the field twenty seconds after the last shot: 7996 ms

browser.expect: the smoke was thinned round the class's men

browser.expect: the gun's shots never went up as a plume
